_comment: Mutation-testing rollout baseline. Scope is src/lib/calc/ ONLY — see docs/mutation-baseline.md for why, and for the rule that a refactor target is added to `mutate` BEFORE it is touched, never after. Run via `npm run mutate`, which wraps Stryker in a guard: a run that fails to start emits no survivors and no score, which reads as a perfect result.
_thresholdsComment: No `break` threshold. This run is a BASELINE, not a gate — it is not wired into the ship gate and must not fail a release. Wiring it in is a separate, deliberate decision.
